who: Albert Morton Craig, historian of Japan at Harvard University; PhD in History and Far Eastern Languages, Harvard 1959.

evidence.says: Identifies Albert M. Craig as Albert Morton Craig, emeritus research professor of Japanese history at Harvard, and author of Chōshū in the Meiji Restoration.
Records his 1959 Harvard doctorate, teaching in Harvard's history department from 1959 to retirement in 1999, and supervision of more than forty doctoral dissertations in Japanese history.

notes: Institution, full-name variant and Japanese-history specialization support the match. Schweber's 2003 completion follows his retirement; her individual supervision was not independently recovered.
